notes: World-class audit, Medium batch 3 + Lows (v12.11, DB v13, additive migration): M10 invoices now track payment — a Record payment button on the invoice preview posts a Received entry to the customer khata and bumps the invoice paid amount in one atomic step; the list shows Paid / balance due, the preview shows Total, Paid and Balance due (Paid in full when done), and the QR, WhatsApp text and PDF all show the balance due instead of the original total. M12 the Udhar entry page top (header, amount, date, notes, DONE) is now a ScrollView constrained above the keypad, so on a short or landscape screen it scrolls instead of sliding underneath the keypad. L1 the statement PDF final page now prints Total given and Total received above the Balance, like the share text. L2 the supplier month card Outstanding is now net (To Pay minus advances, floored at 0; a net advance shows as Advance). L3 the Pay / Collect max-amount error now prints the exact outstanding (999.6) instead of the rounded PKR 1,000 that the check then rejected.
